mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 56 degrees and an air quality index of 53, which is in the moderate range.

City residents should be aware that refuse and recycling services are provided by Pellitteri Waste Systems. Please ensure your carts are at the curb by 7 AM with proper spacing, and check their app or website for collection calendars and e-waste disposal info.

We have plenty happening in town. Today, you can catch a class at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a variety of trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.

In a note from the weekly report, on October 23, officers observed two 13-year-olds riding e-motorcycles on Ashton Drive. Since they had been previously warned, their parents were cited for allowing the minors to operate the prohibited vehicles.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
